entities.summary: Fritz Roeber was a German illustrator, lithographer and history painter, associated with the Düsseldorfer Malerschule. As Director of the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf, he carried out some significant organizational changes. Fritz Roeber was a painters & sculptors from Elberfeld (1851-10-15, Elberfeld–1924-02-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
